data.name: Edul
data.gender_notes: Edul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Edul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ved', which means 'knowledge'. It is also associated with the Tamil word 'Edul', which means 'learning'. This name is bestowed upon a child to inspire a thirst for knowledge and wisdom, and to encourage them to become lifelong learners. The name Edul carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Edul usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Edul represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, which is considered a sacred endeavor in Hinduism. It is believed that through the acquisition of knowledge, one can attain enlightenment and transcend the material world.
data.etymology: Edul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Edul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
